#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,unsigned char scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta+260);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,signed char scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta+255);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,_Bool scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta-2);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,long scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,4294967297LL);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,unsigned char scale,int offset){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale+offset;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale+offset;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta+260,delta-1);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,unsigned char scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale+q->value;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta+260);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}unsigned char consume(struct Node*q,unsigned char scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return (signed char)consume(head,delta+260);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,int d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*q,unsigned char scale,int offset){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=(long long)q->value*scale+offset;free(q);q=tail;}return total+scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta);head=flip(head);return consume(head,delta+260,delta-1);}

struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}long long consume(struct Node*q,int scale){long long total=0;while(q){struct Node*tail=q->next;total+=q->value;free(q);q=tail;}return total/scale;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);return consume(head,delta);}
